base_member_text: [L120-L125, L209-L211, L324-L329] (HIGH/wave-direction calculation) Arithmetic angle averaging mishandles wraparound spectra, while the Snell branch passes an unclamped ratio to asin and can leave its real domain.
audit_member_text: [L120-L126,L209-L211,L324-L329] (HIGH/circular statistics) Mean wave directions are arithmetic angle averages and therefore fail for energy distributed across the angular wrap.
[L122-L125] (HIGH/numerical robustness) The Snell-law asin argument is not clamped and divides by c(1,1) without a zero guard.

adversarial.rationale: The old solver uses an arithmetic angular mean and can fail for a wrapped stored direction array. It is excluded and uncalled in the present library, whose dispatcher selects wave_stationary_directions instead.

neutralizer.quote:
select case (par%wavemodel)
       case(WAVEMODEL_STATIONARY)
         ! call update_means_wave_flow not required: stationary always uses instantaneous water depth s%hhw
         if ((abs(mod(par%t,par%wavint))<0.001d0*par%dt) .or. s%newstatbc==1) then
            call wave_dispersion(s,par,0)  ! use instantaneous water depth (and velocity)
            call wave_stationary_directions(s,par,0)
            s%newstatbc   = 0

base_member_text: [L161-L165] (HIGH/unguarded action conversion) The full row slab is divided by s%sigt without a wet mask or positive-frequency floor.
audit_member_text: [L161-L165,L192-L195] (MED/numerical robustness) Wave-action conversion divides by sigt without guarding zero intrinsic frequency.

adversarial.rationale: The model's dispersion producer floors intrinsic frequency and fills sigt before the active solvers; the old solver is additionally absent from the build/call graph. Lack of a repeated local floor does not establish a zero-frequency defect.

base_member_text: [L199-L207] (HIGH/dry-cell division) The breaker-height correction evaluates H/(gammax*hh) over all cells without excluding zero-depth dry cells, allowing 0/0 and NaN energy.
audit_member_text: [L203-L207] (MED/dry-cell robustness) The depth-limited breaking rescale divides by gammax*s%hh without a wet mask or positive-depth guard.

adversarial.rationale: s%hh is already floored at par%eps by initialization and each flow/morphology update, so a dry cell does not supply zero depth here. The cited old solver is also not selected by the active dispatcher.

audit_member_text: [L41-L72] (LOW/persistent allocation) Saved work arrays and the cached advection scheme are initialized only once, imposing an undocumented invariant that grid dimensions and relevant scheme settings never change.

base_member_text: [L279-L288] (HIGH/division by zero) Both the roller update and reported roller dissipation divide by directional phase-speed magnitude without a positive floor.
audit_member_text: [L279-L288] (HIGH/numerical robustness) Roller source and dissipation updates divide twice by sqrt(cx^2+cy^2) without guarding zero propagation speed.

adversarial.rationale: Only a wet WCI cell whose current cancels intrinsic phase velocity can make this denominator zero; dry cells and non-WCI positive phase speed do not. In addition this older stationary routine is excluded and uncalled.

base_member_text: [L145-L147] (HIGH/CFL calculation) The cross-shore CFL denominator uses maxval(cgx) rather than maxval(abs(cgx)), so a field of large negative propagation velocities yields an excessively large timestep.
audit_member_text: [L143-L147] (HIGH/stability timestep) The x-advection timestep denominator uses maxval(cgx) rather than maxval(abs(cgx)), so an all-negative x velocity field selects the 1e-10 floor and an excessively large timestep.

adversarial.rationale: The missing absolute value is real in the old routine, but the selected replacement uses maxval(abs(cgx)). Even in the old routine the y and theta timestep minima may cap dtw, so an excessively large final timestep additionally requires those constraints to be weak.

neutralizer.quote:
select case (callType)
          case(callTypeStationary)
            dtw=        .5d0*minval(s%dsu(i-1:i+1,jmin_ee:jmax_ee))/max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%cgx(i-1:i+1,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:))))
            dtw=min(dtw,.5d0*minval(s%dnv(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee))      /max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%cgy(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:)      ))))
            dtw=min(dtw,.5d0*dtheta_local                          /max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%ctheta(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:)   ))))
          case(callTypeDirections)
            dtw=        .5d0*minval(s%dsu(i-1:i+1,jmin_ee:jmax_ee))/max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%cgx_s(i-1:i+1,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:))))
            dtw=min(dtw,.5d0*minval(s%dnv(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee))      /max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%cgy_s(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:)      ))))
            dtw=min(dtw,.5d0*dtheta_local                          /max(1.0d-6,maxval(abs(s%ctheta_s(i,jmin_ee:jmax_ee,:)   ))))

base_member_text: [L393-L426] (MED/stale force boundaries) Several Fy boundary entries are deliberately not assigned, so the saved model state can retain values from an earlier stationary solve rather than a defined boundary condition.
audit_member_text: [L393-L426] (MED/boundary initialization) Fy is assigned only on interior i rows and j=1:ny, while its offshore/onshore and final lateral boundary rows are explicitly left unset by commented-out boundary copies.

adversarial.rationale: Fy has a global zero initialization before wave propagation; absent extrapolation does not imply undefined boundary storage. This older routine is also not called by the current wave dispatcher.

base_member_text: [L112-L117] (HIGH/inconsistent hyperbolic limiter) The sinh(2kh) approximation repeats the discontinuous <=3000 test with a cap at 10 and a fixed 3000 value above the threshold.
[L224-L229] (MED/unguarded dry-cell arithmetic) Orbital velocity is computed without a wet/depth guard before its use in bed-friction dissipation.

[L430-L439] (HIGH/incorrect roller-drift selection) The routine computes current roller drift s%ustr but always forms total drift from s%usd, without calling breakerdelay here or selecting ustr when breaker delay is disabled.
